# MassPermits

> MassPermits turns Massachusetts building-permit records into ready-to-work leads for contractors.
> Each lead includes the property address, owner, contractor, project type and project value, organized
> by trade and town. Coverage: 91 towns and neighbourhoods across Cape Cod & Islands, Greater Boston, South Shore & South Coast, MetroWest & 495, North Shore & Merrimack, Central MA and Western MA (75884+ recent permits), drawn from 73 municipal permit sources.
> Massachusetts has 351 municipalities: this is a partial, named subset, itemised source by source
> at https://masspermits.com/research/coverage.

## Products
- Free sample: a masked teaser of the latest permits — https://masspermits.com
- One-time Lead Pack ($49): a current batch of permit leads for a chosen area/trade.
- Weekly Feed ($99/mo): fresh permit leads delivered every week.

## Research (original analysis, method published)
- Research index: https://masspermits.com/research/
- The Friday gap in Massachusetts permit records: https://masspermits.com/research/friday-permit-gap
- Accessory dwelling units, and why the apparent boom is not real: https://masspermits.com/research/adu-permits
- What permit follows what at the same address, and how long after: https://masspermits.com/research/permit-sequence
- Coverage: what each municipal source publishes and what it omits: https://masspermits.com/research/coverage
- Methodology: https://masspermits.com/research/methodology
- Corrections and rejected analyses: https://masspermits.com/research/corrections

## Machine-readable data
- DCAT-US open-data catalog (every town dataset + the research evidence files): https://masspermits.com/catalog.json
- Per-town distributions: https://masspermits.com/feed/<town>.csv, .json (JSON Feed 1.1) and .xml (RSS 2.0)
- CSV column definitions and licence (W3C CSVW sidecar): https://masspermits.com/feed/<town>.csv-metadata.json
- Statewide feeds: https://masspermits.com/feed.xml (RSS), https://masspermits.com/feed/permits.json (JSON Feed), https://masspermits.com/feed/permits.csv
- Research evidence, one file per published figure: https://masspermits.com/research/evidence/coverage.json
- Sitemap: https://masspermits.com/sitemap.xml
- Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). Attribution: MassPermits (masspermits.com).
- Withheld from every published file: house numbers, owner names and contractor names are withheld; the street field is masked to the street name only.
- Aggregates are published; individual rows with identifying columns are the paid product.

## About
- Data source: public municipal building-permit records.
- Buyers: roofers, solar installers, HVAC, electricians, plumbers, remodelers, GCs and more.
- Contact: hello@masspermits.com

## How to cite MassPermits
- Publisher: MassPermits (https://masspermits.com) — a named business; no personal byline.
- Entity id (schema.org): https://masspermits.com/#org
- Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/) — attribution required, non-commercial.
- Method (how every figure is computed): https://masspermits.com/research/methodology
- Coverage — what each source publishes and what it omits: https://masspermits.com/research/coverage
- Corrections and analyses we killed: https://masspermits.com/research/corrections
- Figures behind each research page, as JSON: https://masspermits.com/research/evidence/<slug>.json
- Data as of: 2026-09-11 (newest permit in the corpus behind this build; not the build date).
- Scope of this snapshot: 75884 permits, drawn from 73 municipal permit sources, across 91 towns and neighbourhoods. Massachusetts has 351 municipalities; we do not cover most of them, and https://masspermits.com/research/coverage says exactly which and what each one omits.
- Suggested form: MassPermits. "<page title>". Updated <dateModified from the page's JSON-LD>. <page URL>.
